content:
One thing I love about story-time YouTubers is how they produce such minimal animations, yet still make them very entertaining. It could be just a character speaking on a white background, and yet it still feels incredibly engaging. The mix of audio and minimal animation really does work wonders.

In this way, they are able to produce more content consistently without the hassle of trying to make everything perfect.
"Paragraphs should be like chimps: surprisingly human, but slightly unpredictable. " - Sean J Kernan

The difference between Quora and Substack is that, on Quora, the topic to write about is given by other users, whereas Substack has more of a magazine-like vibe, where the authors determine what to write about.
